implement.summary: Implemented one original Root Bell candidate through actual EnemyActor/HealthState/FrameDamagePolicy/spawn consumers, independently generated six-pose art, fixed ground-lock pulse and real committed-HP interruption. Final unique-output source passed165 actual assertions, five trace-erasure refusals, four output-policy refusals and a repeated actual CLI refusal preserving old bytes. G0/G1 stage record validates without errors; content completion, independent review and G2-G5 remain unverified. Production admission remains false and original560px threshold/1-of20 candidate result are retained.
findings: Ready for a different actual read-only reviewer; author does not grant ACCEPT. Portable index: docs/evidence/region_production_v3/enemy/README.md; design: docs/quality/region_production_v3/root_bell_design.md.

Six independent 400/440/560-width directed real Motor fixtures cross a living enemy and real pulse by one base jump without damage/shooting; min live contact-envelope vertical clearance93.36px. These are not continuous out/return or full-region proofs, and do not themselves lower formal admission.

A separate623-frame/10.383s1280x72060fps stereo48k movie shows one continuous no-damage fight: jump/walk bypass, three true projectile HP hits, two interruptions, one death and walk-through. It is a specialist fixture, not a formal generated route, and audio was not actually listened to for quality judgment.

Original movie v1 fourteen-file source bytes are archived with matching SHA256. Old Python producer had already changed before archival; exact inverse patch reconstruction matched the original movie SHA and is explicitly labelled verified reconstruction. New unique-output producer has separate fresh G1 source; observer-only diff and scope bridge are retained.

Earlier fixed-output runner overwrote two full-frame failed captures; those original bytes cannot be recovered. Original failure logs survive and this limitation is explicit. New producer reserves a new directory, refuses existing output before engine start, and native producer also refuses existing started/capture files. Actual repeated CLI exited1 with all old success bytes unchanged and no engine run.

Full formal encounter/complete DemoApp reload, formal visual/animation/audio admission, target performance, user and physical-device acceptance remain unverified. Global assets manifest registration and promotion are parent-owned future work. Boss/Motor/resource/capability/save/RNG service rules were not changed.
